pallas_call.what: the entry point: kernel, out_shape, grid, in_specs, out_specs, scratch_shapes, interpret, compiler_params

interpret_doc.what: docstring: interpret mode is a jit of a scan over the grid, "the only way to run Pallas kernels on CPU"

lowering.what: one lowering rule, three outcomes: interpret, TPU (Mosaic), GPU (Triton or Mosaic GPU)

interp_branch.what: interpret=True picks the HLO interpreter; an InterpretParams object picks the TPU interpreter

cpu_error.what: the error you get without interpret=True on CPU

gridspec.what: GridSpec: grid plus in/out specs plus scratch shapes

hlo_ignores.what: it drops compiler_params, so dimension_semantics is ignored

hlo_while.what: the while loop over grid points

hlo_dslice.what: blocks are cut with dynamic_slice, which clamps out-of-range starts (no error)

uninit.what: outputs start uninitialised (NaN on CPU), so a forgotten zero-init shows

tpu_params.what: TPU interpret mode: DMAs, semaphores, cores, race detection, random order of parallel axes

oob.what: the TPU interpreter raises on an out-of-range block

randomize.what: parallel grid axes are walked in a random order

default_arbitrary.what: the default: every axis arbitrary, so nothing is split over a megacore's two cores

tpu_info.what: per-generation table: lanes, sublanes, MXU size and count, VMEM, SMEM, HBM

megacore.what: megacore only on v4 and v5p
